name: Switchpoint quote caller
description: Outbound, consented quote-gathering call for a Massachusetts household. Fuel dealers and heat pump installers, one call each, four minutes maximum.
notes: ADR-010: no webhooks, no database. The browser holds the conversation id and polls.
R19.8: real businesses are dialled only when PROVIDER_CALLS_ENABLED=true.
R22.2: the browser deletes each conversation with DELETE /api/calls/[sessionId].
